network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto regionale conferma il crollo del ponte San Bartolomeo durante l'evento del 10-12 dicembre 2021, ma non fornisce una misura idrometrica tabulata e riferibile alla sezione del ponte. L'ingrossamento descritto non viene trasformato in portata.
network_status.summary_en: The regional report confirms collapse of the San Bartolomeo bridge during the 10-12 December 2021 event but provides no tabulated hydrometric measurement attributable to the bridge section. The described rise is not converted into discharge.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
